description: Read one article as Markdown with its canonical URL, date, tags, audio link and the URLs of its other language (languages). Slugs differ per language; without language the German article is preferred.

language.description: Language of the articles: "de" (German, the default) or "en" (English translations). Every article exists in both.

slug.description: Article slug: the last path segment of its URL.

name: get_article
